The pinned selector embedded a runtime-computed byte count, 1212174, taken from the smoke's synthetic 100-command fixture. The number changed because the fixture became more truthful, not because behaviour regressed. The behaviour this intent asserts - an artifact below the warning fraction prints no advisory - IS proven, by the section now reading 'realistic 100-command artifact is unbounded and silent', which asserts both bounded=false and a null advisory.
